title: Embedded NULs force a full source-index probe chain
claim: Moving an embedded NUL between source name and value leaves the hashed bytes identical for 256 distinct source tuples regardless of the randomized seed; source admission requires 32,896 probes in one request instead of a short low-load probe sequence.

title: Oversized sources are fully hashed before the root limit is checked
claim: Live source admission hashes entire strings or byte slices before the store rejects inputs longer than its 64 KiB root limit, paying linear work for guaranteed drops.
